decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains distant from the firm's core building and industrial lighting knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on ergonomic task-lighting expertise and its dedicated page helps the firm interpret early results.
General interior lighting is directly within the firm's core building lighting domain, so its related knowledge strongly supports retaining the product.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics aligns with the firm's optical and energy-efficient direction, making it a high-priority keeper.
The marine searchlight is close enough to the firm's outdoor and industrial lighting expertise to be improved with existing R&D capabilities.
